message:
The vulnerability is "array lookup with wrong indices due to missing validation before accessing the array". Let me look at the git history to find the vulnerability and check the test/fuzzers directory.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4 && git log --oneline -20 && echo "---" && ls test/fuzzers/ 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && git diff HEAD~1 HEAD --stat 2>/dev/null | head -30</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
